% PDF-6b fixture. Compiled with pdfTeX and without a ToUnicode CMap, so every
% Computer Modern font in the PDF is a Type 1 program with a built-in encoding
% and no /ToUnicode - the shape pdfTeX-1.40.18 produced for NBER WP 24458
% (issue #232). TeX Live 2025's LaTeX format turns ToUnicode on by default, so
% the fixture switches it off explicitly; nothing else is non-default.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\pdfgentounicode=0
\begin{document}
Efficient finance is the first topic here: fluffy affluent firms do well.
The tail probability is $0.5\%$ at a scale of $10^{-12}$ in this model.
Greek letters stay readable too: $\alpha + \beta = \gamma$ and $\Gamma$.
This last sentence is plain text with no math and no ligature at all.
\end{document}
